relationships.subject: losartan potassium
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal administration of LOP effectively inhibited SNI-induced NOX2 overactivation in microglia and suppressed the HMGB1/NF-kB pathway

relationships.subject: NOX2
relationships.evidence_quote: Additionally, NOX2 overexpression triggered the activation of the high-mobility group box 1/nuclear factor-kappa B (HMGB1/NF-κB) signaling pathway.

relationships.subject: losartan potassium
relationships.evidence_quote: Blockade of AT1R with losartan potassium (LOP) suppressed NOX2-mediated oxidative stress

key_findings: SNI increased AT1R and NOX2 in dorsal horn microglia with M1-like activation and oxidative stress
Spinal AT1R blockade with losartan suppressed NOX2/HMGB1/NF-κB, shifted microglia M1 to M2 and reduced pain hypersensitivity
